conventions.BaseColor: sRGB, linear albedo calibrated (Rec.709 luminance mean = albedo_target_mean_lum_linear); kind modulation_set: neutral map with mean 0.5, engine albedo = 2 x manifest colour x map
conventions.MaskMap: URP Lit: R metallic, G occlusion, B detail mask, A smoothness; import sRGB off
conventions.Normal: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y = +v), Unity/glTF convention; import as Normal map
conventions.Var: R height normalised over height_range_m, G per-element random id (block/slab/chip; point sampled, never averaged), B joint/crack/bare mask (water, dirt, weeds), A convexity/edge wear; import sRGB off, mip filter box
conventions.albedo_source: 'Cool Pavements' review, arXiv:2409.12242 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12242), p. 7: new asphalt concrete ~0.05, rising with ageing and soiling to ~0.15; Portland cement concrete up to 0.35, soiled ~0.2 within weeks/months. Broadband solar albedo, not visible-band: the texture means are WORKING_VALUE placed inside those ranges
conventions.anti_tiling: (1) macro_variation at 64 m and 264 m rotated (existing shader path); (2) Var.G element id + world tile index hash -> per-element tone jitter (paving, slabs); (3) distinct features (cracks, sealant) only in the 16 m crack layer, faded by macro B; (4) optional second base sample at x2.71 scale on High
conventions.cc0_scans: ADR 0063: sets with a `source` entry are built from CC0 scans (Poly Haven, manifest art-source/world/cc0/cc0_manifest.json, processing _src/sets_scan.py): de-lit, flattened above ~1 m, white-balanced to the previous set mean and calibrated to the same target; height integrated from the scan normals; isotropic scans re-assembled (texture bombing) into 4 m tiles; hybrids keep the procedural layout and take the scan micro-detail
conventions.grass_albedo_source: WORKING_VALUE (visible-band albedo of mown grass; no measured source in repo)
conventions.mipmaps: Unity-generated, Kaiser filter for BaseColor; aniso 4 (Medium) / 8 (High); hf_ratio_albedo = share of albedo variance above half Nyquist (shimmer risk; values in each set entry)
conventions.tiers: High = generated resolution (2048 for square sets), Medium = /2, Low = /4, box-filtered from High in linear space; smoothness per tier gets the normal variance lost by the downsample (Toksvig-style) so distant surfaces do not sparkle
conventions.units: metres; tile_m = world size of one texture repeat

asphalt_cracks_layer.note: Mask: R open crack coverage (crack 1-5 mm, meandering, branched, broken into 2-12 m runs), G sealant band 25-40 mm (glossy bitumen, smoothness ~0.55, albedo ~0.03), B alligator zone, A ravelled halo. Normal: crack/sealant relief, blend with RNM/whiteout. Suggested: albedo *= lerp(1, 0.35, R) then lerp to 0.03 by G; smoothness lerp to 0.55 by G; scale R by a per-road age factor and by macro B so whole stretches can be crack-free (REVIEW r2 #5, r3 W8).
slots: overlay on road_asphalt / yard_asphalt / path_asphalt (not on asphalt_sma_fresh)

asphalt_detail_photo.note: From the public-domain photo Worn_cracked_asphalt_pavement.jpg (John Harvey, Wikimedia Commons): crack-free crop, luminance high-pass, contrast-normalised, made tileable (variance-preserving offset blend). DetailAlbedo follows URP: albedo *= tex * unity_ColorSpaceDouble, so sRGB 128 = neutral (x1.0), range ~x0.75..x1.3. Scale ~0.9 mm/px estimated from the aggregate size: WORKING_VALUE.
asphalt_detail_photo.note_low: Low tier: no detail layer (bandwidth); the base sets alone.
slots: URP-style detail albedo + detail normal on asphalt_worn, asphalt_patch, asphalt_sma_fresh
asphalt_detail_photo.uv: world_xy_planar x1 (close-range detail, fade out beyond ~25 m)

asphalt_patch.note: Newer AC 8 patch fill, darker than the road around it (fresh binder, 0.05 class). The decal's TEXCOORD_1.x (age 0..1) should lerp albedo toward asphalt_worn and smoothness down.

asphalt_sma_fresh.note: SMA 11 wearing course a few months in service: binder film still on the chips, slight sheen.
slots: road_asphalt (sections resurfaced recently: proposed material road_asphalt_new)

asphalt_worn.note: Aged AC 11 (albedo 0.08, was 0.13; paint/asphalt contrast, ADR 0049 addendum r7): exposed light aggregate, ravelling sockets, dust in voids, low-contrast hairline micro-cracking only. Distinct cracks come from asphalt_cracks_layer (16 m) so this 4 m base has no recognisable features.

bark_pine.note: Plated pine bark, neutral modulation map (mean 0.5 per channel); colour from the manifest.
slots: (not assigned) tree trunks - vegetation is the world-builder's scope (ADR 0060)

barrier_galv.note: Weathered galvanised W-beam element 4.0 m (ADR 0117): u along, v unrolled across the folded profile (0.472 m); splice bolts, lap edge, road dust on up-facing flanks, bottom-edge spray, sparse rust.

behaton_i_grey.note: I-shaped (double-T) interlocking 8 cm blocks 200 x 166 mm, waist 120 mm (WORKING_VALUE), rows offset half a block, 3-4 mm sand joints with moss away from traffic. Var.G = block id: the shader should add hash(block id + world tile index) tone jitter so the 4 m tile never repeats.

box_panel.note: Box body panels with seam profiles every 1.2 m, road film low down.

brick.note: Brick NF 250 x 65 mm, 10 mm mortar, stretcher bond, per-brick tone.

car_grime.note: Parked-car paint film: road spray on sills, dust on top, rain runs (u along body, v = height).

concrete_cast_5m_joints.note: 5 x 5 m cast slabs, 8 mm sawn joints with bitumen sealant (open stretches with dirt), broom finish, worn exposed sand, one corner break and one transverse crack per 10 m tile. Var.G = slab id. Joint lines are world-aligned: for road_concrete they need along-road UV (UV1).

concrete_fence_panel.note: Prefab concrete panel fence: 2 m bays, 0.5 m panels, pores, joints, splash grime, run-off.

concrete_precast.note: Precast plinth panels, 6 m bays, formwork ties, pores, run-off.

concrete_slab_3x1.5.note: Precast road plates 3.0 x 1.5 m ('JOMB' type), rows with irregular offsets, 12-32 mm soil joints (some with grass), worn arrises, settlement steps up to +-6 mm, lifting-socket notches. Albedo mean measured on plates only (joints excluded).

container_corrugation.note: Container side corrugation 0.278 m pitch, dents, rust spots.

curtain_folds.note: Curtainsider tarpaulin folds, sag between straps, grime on the lower third.

facade_atlas.note: Cell atlas 16 x 16 m. Calibrated: every cell carries its real albedo (tint 1).
slots: facade_atlas (windows, doors, garage doors, balustrades, facade equipment; ADR 0081)

facade_far.note: Storey rows of 8 bays composed from the facade_atlas cells; wall = neutral 0.5 tinted by the wall colour.
facade_far.uv: mesh_uv0_metres (u = bay x 3 m, v = row; layout facade_atlas.FAR_*)

fence_concrete.note: Strip atlas 16 x 4.5 m: 8 bays of stacked 0.5 m plates, 5 framed panels, post strip. Micro detail from the CC0 scan concrete_floor_worn_001 (Poly Haven) when fetched.

fire_station.note: Atlas 14 x 14 m (2048 x 2048 High, 6.8 mm/texel): pale blue render band with splash zone and run-off, blue trapezoidal roof sheet, flashing, plinth, sectional door, clinker pier, windows, swatches. Detail / relief / roughness from CC0 scans (Poly Haven: Painted Plaster Wall, Brick Wall 006, Concrete Wall 008); colours WORKING_VALUE by eye from CC0 photos. albedo_target_mean_lum_linear applies to the clean render, not the atlas mean.
fire_station.source: polyhaven:painted_plaster_wall (CC0); polyhaven:concrete_wall_008 (CC0); polyhaven:brick_wall_006 (CC0); polyhaven:fir_tree_01 needle RGB (CC0; authored opaque canopy derivative)
fire_station.uv: mesh_uv0_metres (atlas position in metres; layout in art-source/world/landmarks/fire_station_jrg2/atlas_layout.json)

grass_verge.note: Mown verge from above (z-buffered blades, 2x supersampled): tufts, thatch, bare soil, plantain/dandelion rosettes, clover. Extra albedo BaseColor_late_autumn (olive-brown; REVIEW r3 W10). Var.B = bare soil (more mud near kerbs via COLOR_0 masks).

gravel_compacted.note: Compacted crushed stone 0-31.5 mm: two stone sizes half-buried in fines and dust.

hedge_foliage.note: Clipped red berberis hedge face: leaf clusters, dark voids, thin holes (u along, v over the section).

kerb_concrete_1m.note: Precast kerb units 1.0 m (PN-EN 1340 kerb 15x30), mortar joints, chipped arrises. Tile 2 m x 0.5 m, non-square texture (2048x512 High). Aged, grime-darkened kerb (0.28 after photo comparison with Rondo Bieżeństwa; 0.33 read as white lines).

large_panel_joints.note: Large-panel block: 3.0 x 2.8 m panels, sealed joints, per-panel tone.

macro_variation.note: R 8-64 m tone, G 2-16 m tone (both drop-in for the current _MacroMap R/G), B wear/dirt patches 1.5-24 m, A 0.5-4 m mottling. All centred on 0.5, linear (import sRGB off).
macro_variation.uv: world_xy_planar (sample twice: 64 m and 64 m x 4.13 rotated, as Kamion/World Surface does)

noise_cassette.note: Absorbing noise-barrier cassettes 4.0 x 0.5 m, perforated face, joint lips, splash grime, run-off.

oil_stain_alpha.note: 2x2 atlas, one stain per cell in the decal's radial UV (centre 0.5/0.5): 0 drip pool, 1 tyre smear (elongated, for yards), 2 old faded ring, 3 drip cluster. Cell = floor(seed*4) from TEXCOORD_1.y; BaseColor.a = opacity; cell borders fade to 0 so mips do not bleed.

parapet_runoff.note: Run-off streaks under the parapet coping of halls (zacieki pod attyka): R soot/dirt, G rust, linear. Long streaks below coping-sheet joints every 2-3 m, fine drip lines, broad smudges, uneven dirty band under the drip edge; fades to 0 at 4 m. One RGB sample on wall pixels, all tiers (Low 256x40). Look WORKING_VALUE (photo-judged, no measurements).
parapet_runoff.uv: mesh_uv1 (u metres along the wall, v = 1 + metres below the attic fascia / length scale; v < 0.5 = no wall-top data)

paving_20x10_grey.note: Rectangular 200 x 100 mm 'holland' blocks, running bond, 4-shade grey melange. Var.G = block id (same anti-repeat trick as behaton).

plaster.note: Thin-coat plaster grain with trowel clouds and streaks.

roof_tiles.note: S-profile roof tile courses, roll pitch 0.20 m, gauge 0.35 m (u along the eave, v up the slope).

sandwich_ribbed.note: Horizontal sandwich panels 1.0 m, micro-lined face, shadow-gap joints, run-off streaks.

sectional_door.note: Sectional door leaves 0.5 m with a mid-panel rib, stucco grain, scuffed bottom.

sidewalk_slab_35.note: Square concrete sidewalk slabs (plyty chodnikowe 35x35x5), scan scaled from ~0.30 m to 0.35 m slabs (WORKING_VALUE). Var.G = slab id from the scan's displacement.
slots: (not assigned yet) sidewalk slabs 35x35 cm, older footways

soil_bed.note: Island planting bed: loam with bark mulch chips, a few stones, leaf litter (u, v plan metres).

trapezoid_sheet.note: Trapezoidal sheet, vertical ribs 0.25 m pitch, 35 mm deep (T35-like, WORKING_VALUE).

viaduct_concrete.note: Strip atlas 24 x 12 m (4096 x 2048 High): red cornice band, unrolled box-girder half section, unrolled column, abutment wall, swatches. Base detail / relief / roughness from the CC0 scan 'Concrete Wall 008' (Poly Haven); pours, formwork, drains, drips, soot, leak streaks generated. albedo_target_mean_lum_linear applies to the clean concrete of the girder band, not the atlas mean.
viaduct_concrete.uv: mesh_uv0_metres (u along the bridge, v = band position; layout in art-source/world/landmarks/viaduct_biezenstwa/atlas_layout.json)
